description: This file defines an Angular component 'ExpandedTimelineComponent' responsible for rendering an expandable timeline view, which displays multiple traces with icons and individual timelines, along with associated styles and event handling.

classes.name: ExpandedTimelineComponent
classes.description: Angular component that renders an expanded timeline with multiple traces and timelines.

methods.name: getTraces
methods.description: Returns an array of trace objects to be rendered.

methods.name: onResize
methods.description: Handles window resize event to resize canvases accordingly.

methods.name: trackTraceBySelectedTimestamp
methods.description: Track traces by their current timestamp for efficient rendering.

methods.name: resizeCanvases
methods.description: Resizes all timeline canvases for proper display.
